description: Ling 3.0 Flash VL is inclusionAI's native multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 124B total parameters and 5.5B active parameters per token. It combines image and video understanding with reasoning and tool use for document analysis, charts, visual verification, and interface-based agent tasks. Thinking is enabled by default and can be turned off in settings.
name: Ling 3.0 Flash VL
